hints.title: Standard String Comparison
hints.text: Because times are given in format 'HH:MM' with leading zeros, standard lexicographical comparison matches chronological order.

hints.title: Interval Overlap Condition
hints.text: Two closed intervals [start1, end1] and [start2, end2] conflict if and only if start1 <= end2 and start2 <= end1.

hints.title: Direct Boolean Return
hints.text: Return true if the intersection condition holds, false otherwise.

hints.title: Interval Overlap Condition Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct string comparisons execute in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overcomplicating with minute conversions when lexicographical comparison already suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates directly on input references.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard interval overlap condition (start1 <= end2 and start2 <= end1).
